messages:
ashley: Quick: running a mini BYOK drill tomorrow 10:00 PT in staging. Scope: JIT RBAC, audit fields, rewrap fallback. No prod HSM touches.

kevin: ACK. Will we import synthetic key material or replay a customer BYOK flow?

ashley: Synthetic in staging HSM. Goal: verify admin_session_id, actor_role, mfa_present are logged and that revocation triggers rewrap.

maria: Ensure log digest capability for SOC2. Need ability to show immutability (sha256) and RBAC diffs.

tony: I'll create a JIT role scoped to staging. Deny block for prod ARNs and ttl=30m.

sec-bot: :warning: Runbook missing "notify-legal". Add before execution.

kevin: Suggest pre-create emergency unseal in Vault (2-approver) and record unseal ops in logs. Also add alert for rewrap non-2xx.

ashley: Good. I'll update runbook and post invite. Short checklist: JIT role, log fields, emergency token, legal notify, postmortem template.

maria: After-action: timeline, RBAC delta, signed log digest, and compliance memo.

ashley: Thanks — will tag reviewers once updated.
